name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: A library of ready-made add-ons for the Cursor AI coding tool that connect it to things like Gmail, Salesforce, and GitHub so it can act directly on your other business tools.
buyer: Mainly useful to developers already using Cursor who want to extend it; there is no strong standalone buyer beyond that.
business_use_cases: A sales engineer installs the Salesforce and Gong plugins so their AI assistant can pull deal context directly into coding or automation sessions.
A recruiter installs the Ashby plugin so an AI assistant can draft interview prep notes directly from candidate pipeline data.
An agency copies the plugin spec pattern to build a custom internal plugin connecting Cursor to a client's proprietary tool.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a custom plugin connecting Cursor to a niche business tool this list doesn't cover yet, to companies already using that tool.

steal_this: This weekend, build one plugin for a popular tool missing from this list (a niche CRM or helpdesk) and list it for other Cursor users to install.
